description: I'm Stephen Acorn, A Constitutional Conservative and proud American Patriot. I am a devoted husband to my wife, and kids. With deep-rooted Christian and family values, I believe in preserving the God-given, Constitutional rights of the American people. I want to represent the voices of the people of Georgia's District 137 because I want an economic environment where everyone thrives. Acorn For Georgia!
title: Acorn For Georgia State House | District 137
